findings.title: Runtime guard refuses planted mutation

legacy_root.hard_constraint: No real credential was read, printed, rotated, revoked, unset or modified. Only a synthetic planted call name was used.
legacy_root.mechanism: Python AST Call nodes plus a comment/string-stripped JS call scan, plus shell/provider CLI patterns. Detector control is a planted revoke_token() that must fire before a zero live hit is trusted. Runtime guard installs refusing callables into a test-build namespace; the unguarded plant is reachable against a fake sink.
